main_text.l: omnibus operibus tuis omnipotentiam, sapi-
entiam, bonitatem, iustitiam, misericordiam,
& veritatem tuam venerémur, prædicemus, &
celebremus{a}: Deinde ut universam vitam no-
stram, cogitationes, sermones & actiones eo
semper dirigamus: ne sanctissimum nomen tu-
um propter nos contumelia afficiatur, sed Ho-
nore potius & laudibus illustretur{b}.
Veniat regnum tuum, hoc est, regas nos ita
verbo & Spiritu tuo, ut nos tibi magis magis-
que subiiciamus{c}: conserva & auge Ecclesiam
tuam{d}, destrue opera diaboli, omnemque po-
tentiam se adversus maiestatem tuam efferen-
tem, irrita fac omnia consilia, quæ contra ver-
bum tuum capiuntur{e}, quoad plene tandem ac
perfecte regnes{f} cum eris omnia in omnibus{g}.

l.i: Fiat voluntas tua, quemadmodum in cœlo, sic etiam

main_text.l: in terra:hoc est, Da ut nos & omnes, homi-
nes, voluntati propriæ renunciantes{h}, tuæ vo-
luntati, quæ sola est sancta, prompte & sine ullo
murmure pareamus{i}: atque ita singuli manda-
tum nobis munus fideliter & alacriter exequamur{k},
quemadmodum faciunt angeli in cœlo.
Panem nostrum quotidianum da nobis hodie.hoc
est, suppeditta nobis omnia, quæ sunt ad hanc
vitam necessaria{l}, ut per ea agnoscamus, te
unicum fonte esse ex quo omnia, bona emana[?]

page.notes: Final word "emana[?]" is cut off at the edge of this part. Reference marks a to l are in the text, but their notes are not in this part. The printed signature "Tt ij" and the mark "ac" at the foot of the visible area were left out, as instructed for this part. The petition headings are read as level 2 titles above passages. The first paragraph continues from the previous page. The letter "g" before "r.co" and the "k" of the last reference in the second group are doubtful: the first reads "gr" and the second "k1" (k with a figure or l-like mark). The "Ier e" of Jeremiah is uncertain, as is the abbreviation "Iere." Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Several marks in the margin (a, b, c, d, e, f, h, i, k, l, m) were read by shape and may be partly misread.
